events.text: A large white rabbit stands stretching its arms wide outside a grassy burrow entrance.
The camera viewpoint shifts to a low angle looking up at the rabbit's face against a blue sky with soft clouds.
The large white rabbit looks slightly to the left with a gentle smile under leafy tree branches.
The camera viewpoint moves to show white flowers with yellow centers in the foreground and the rabbit walking near a tree in the background.
The rabbit stands on hind legs with arms outstretched in a field of green grass with scattered flowers.
The rabbit is close to the flowers smelling them with a content expression.
The pink butterfly flutters closely around the rabbit's head while the rabbit watches it.
